paite: Aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa un; thillamdangtakte ahihta ngal a! Akhut taklam leh aban siangthou in amah a ding in hotdamna ahihsakta hi.
heading: Phatna La / Pathian, Khovel Vaihawmpa

paite: TOUPA'N ahotdamna atheisak a, adiktatna namte mitmuh in chiantak in alangsakta hi.
Israel inkuanpihte tung a azahngaihna leh aginomdan atheigige a; kawlmong a mi tengteng in, Pathian hotdamna amuta uhi.
Leitung luah tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in kikou unla; kikoukhia unla nuamsa in la sa un, ahi, phatna la sa un.
Kaihging toh TOUPA phat in la sa un, kaihging leh phatna la husa toh.
Pengkulte leh pengkul binei ging toh kumpipa, TOUPA ma ah, nuamsatak in kikou un.
Tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng lum honhon hen; khovel leh asung a tengteng toh,
luipite'n akhut uh beng uhenla; mualte'n nuam in la sakhawm uhen,
TOUPA ma ah; lei vaihawm ding in, ahong pai dek ngal a khovel diktattak in vai ahawmsak ding a, khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawmsak ding hi.
